input_contract: Infrastructure exposure graph / resource abstraction JSON.

guarantee.meaning_of_pass: No sensitive resource is publicly exposed in the abstraction.
guarantee.meaning_of_fail: A sensitive resource has a public exposure path.
guarantee.meaning_of_unknown: The infrastructure abstraction was missing or malformed.

assumptions: Resource sensitivity and exposure edges faithfully represent planned state.
limits: Does not execute Terraform/Kubernetes; evaluates the supplied abstraction only.
failure_semantics: Malformed abstractions map to unknown; evaluator errors map to error.
unsupported_semantics: Does not prove runtime cloud configurations beyond the abstraction.
